headline: Parliament debate heats up over interpretation of Quranic verse
summary: Members of the government and opposition parties clashed in the National Parliament over the meaning of a verse from the Holy Quran during budget discussions.
details: A heated debate erupted in the National Parliament on Wednesday during discussions on the proposed budget for the 2026-27 fiscal year.
caption:
A Quranic verse sparked a clash in Parliament!

A heated debate erupted in the National Parliament on Wednesday during discussions on the proposed budget for the 2026-27 fiscal year.

headline_marked: Govt to ensure [[financial transparency at Shahjalal Mazar]], Minister says
headline: Govt to ensure financial transparency at Shahjalal Mazar, Minister says
summary: Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment Minister Md Ariful Islam has backed the move by the outgoing Sylhet DC to ensure transparency in shrine donations.
details: Minister Md Ariful Islam praised the outgoing Deputy Commissioner (DC) of Sylhet, Sarwar Hossain, for his efforts to bring transparency to the financial dealings of the Shahjalal (R) Mazar.
The Minister stated that the government will provide full cooperation to ensure that the donations received at the shrine are managed transparently and accountably.
This development follows the viral spread of a phone conversation involving the former DC, which highlighted issues regarding the management of the shrine's funds.
The Minister noted that the former DC's actions have 'opened our eyes' to the existing irregularities in the management of the shrine's finances.
The government aims to implement a system where the public can trust that their donations to the shrine are being used for their intended purposes.
caption:
Donations at the Shahjalal (R) Mazar will now be managed with full transparency. The government has stepped in to back the outgoing Sylhet DC's move.

Minister Md Ariful Islam praised the outgoing Deputy Commissioner (DC) of Sylhet, Sarwar Hossain, for his efforts to bring transparency to the financial dealings of the Shahjalal (R) Mazar.

The Minister stated that the government will provide full cooperation to ensure that the donations received at the shrine are managed transparently and accountably.

This development follows the viral spread of a phone conversation involving the former DC, which highlighted issues regarding the management of the shrine's funds.

The Minister noted that the former DC's actions have 'opened our eyes' to the existing irregularities in the management of the shrine's finances.

The government aims to implement a system where the public can trust that their donations to the shrine are being used for their intended purposes.

#Bangladesh #Sylhet #ShahjalalMazar #Transparency #Governance

Source: Somoy News, Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV
